name: deadlock_timeout
description: Time to wait on a lock before initiating a deadlock detection check.
symptoms: Unnecessary CPU overhead from frequent deadlock checks
Excessive 'lock wait' log messages when log_lock_waits is enabled
False-positive deadlock aborts under high contention
tuning_tips: Set slightly above the 95th percentile of typical transaction duration to avoid premature deadlock checks; increase cautiously if false deadlocks are observed, but avoid setting too high to prevent delayed error reporting.
